newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt miller doubles 95/96 yield, profit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt miller doubles 95/96 yield, profit.

text.p: Blue-chip North Cairo Flour Mills said on Sunday it was doubling dividends for the financial year 1995/6 to 11.25 pounds from 5.04 for 1994/95.
The financial years end on June 30.
The yield for each of the miller's six million shares exceeded earlier forecasts of 10 pounds a share.
But at about 1000 GMT, North Cairo shares were trading on the Egyptian stock exchange at between 135.00 and 137.00 pounds, down from Thursday's close of 139.99 pounds.

North Cairo Flour Mills, one of the state's first and most successful privatisations, almost doubled distributable profits in 1995/96 to 88.7 million pounds ($26.10 million) from 48.0 million a year earlier.
The firm said it was increasing its output and storage capacity but did not forecast production levels for the current financial year.
Net sales in 1995/96 were higher at 816.8 million pounds from 645.6 million in 1994/95.
